bugs_found: apply_fee computes fee as pct*pct (squared) instead of a*pct, producing wrong fee amounts
apply_fee does not validate that fee_pct is a sensible percentage (e.g., <= 1 or <= 100) and applies clamping after a meaningless squaring
loan_payment does not validate principal > 0 nor reject NaN/extreme values; r==0 branch returns p/m without rounding to currency precision
compound_interest accepts annual_rate without upper bound and does not round result to monetary precision
transfer mutates account balances without atomicity/transaction safety; on partial failure between debit and credit the state can be inconsistent
transfer uses 'is' identity check for self-transfer, missing the case where two distinct Account objects share the same id
fx_convert does not validate that rate is positive/non-zero and silently allows zero or negative rates from the dict
fx_convert lookup is one-directional; missing inverse-rate fallback or triangulation, causing ValueError even when inverse rate exists
Decimal conversions via str() do not enforce quantization to currency scale, so results may carry excessive precision and downstream rounding errors
No use of decimal.Context / ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding on monetary outputs
